tagline: International Association representing European inland navigation interests
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of participants at the annual congress reflects the engagement of stakeholders in the European inland navigation sector. With 215 participants from 11 European countries in 2024, this KPI measures the reach and influence of the association as a representative platform for the industry.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the IVR annual congress, representing key stakeholders in the European inland navigation sector from multiple countries.
kpis.description: IVR is an association representing the interests of European inland navigation. The number of participants at the annual congress reflects the engagement of key industry players and the association's ability to bring together stakeholders.
kpis.signal: 215 participants at the 2024 Frankfurt congress, from 11 European countries (May 15-17, 2024)

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendees
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the first edition of the Loss Prevention Colloquium organized by IVR, bringing together professionals from the inland navigation sector.
kpis.description: First edition of an IVR initiative aimed at gathering professionals around technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.
kpis.signal: 80 participants at the first Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (November 4, 2024), from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany
